hero.title: Where Little Minds Grow & Sparkle
hero.subtitle: A safe, fun, and advanced educational environment for your children.

philosophy.title: Nurturing Every Good Seed
philosophy.description: At Good Seed Daycare, we believe that every child is a unique seed with boundless potential. Planted in the right environment, with love, care, and advanced education, they will grow into brilliant minds.

infant.title: Little Sprouts
infant.desc: A gentle, loving, and sensory-rich environment designed to make your baby feel secure and stimulate early brain development.

toddler.title: Curious Seedlings
toddler.desc: An active, playful space where toddlers develop fine motor skills, language, and social connections through guided exploration.

preschool.title: Blooming Trees
preschool.desc: An advanced, structured curriculum focusing on reading readiness, math concepts, and creative arts to prepare them for Kindergarten.

features.title: The Right Soil for Your Seed
